# Upgrading to the full pack

This lite pack is one effect (level-up burst). The full **Pickup, Buff & Heal VFX**
pack is the same system with six effects and the full texture set.

| | Lite (this) | Pickup, Buff & Heal VFX |
|---|---|---|
| Effects | 1 (level-up) | 6 (sparkle pickup, level-up, heal glow, buff aura, shield bubble, ring pulse) |
| Shape textures | 3 | 8 |
| System (shaders, ring, sparks, light) | ✓ | ✓ |

Installs alongside the full pack without clashing. Lite classes are `FreeBuffFx*`,
full ones `BuffFx*`. On the same store account.
